Description: Ingest NPCI, Switch and CBS data
Match and classify transactions
Track T+1 reversal and compensation
Work queue, maker-checker, audit
SMS and NPCI UDIR
Dashboards and MIS
As a recon analyst I want the NPCI file downloaded automatically so that I avoid manual work.
Acceptance Criteria: Given file on SFTP When scheduler runs at 07:00 Then file loaded status RECEIVED; if missing retry every 15 min x5 then alert

Description: As an ops supervisor I want files validated so that bad data is not loaded.
Acceptance Criteria: Trailer mismatch rejected RECORD_COUNT_MISMATCH; duplicate blocked DUPLICATE_FILE

Description: As a recon analyst I want switch and CBS data loaded for the same date so that 3-way matching is possible.
Acceptance Criteria: Load summary shows record counts per source

Description: As a recon analyst I want automatic matching on RRN, amount, date, status.
Acceptance Criteria: Perfect match -> RECONCILED; amount mismatch -> EX07

Description: As a recon analyst I want a fallback match so fewer records become exceptions.
Acceptance Criteria: Match on amount + VPA + 5 min window flagged SECONDARY

Description: As an ops supervisor I want mismatches categorised EX01-EX08.
Acceptance Criteria: CBS debit + NPCI FAILED -> EX01 with due date T+1

Description: As a compliance officer I want reversal tracked against T+1.
Acceptance Criteria: Reversed within TAT auto-closed; else TAT_BREACH and compensation record

Description: As a finance officer I want Rs100/day compensation computed automatically.
As an analyst I want a prioritised queue.
Acceptance Criteria: Sorted by SLA breach, age, amount; filter by category/status

Description: As a supervisor I want to approve adjustments before posting.
Acceptance Criteria: Maker cannot approve own entry; approval posts to CBS and stores reference

Description: As an auditor I want an immutable action log.
Acceptance Criteria: Audit record with user, time, old/new value; not editable

Description: As a customer I want SMS on failure and refund.
Acceptance Criteria: SMS sent on closure with CBS ref; delivery status stored

Description: As a dispute analyst I want to raise UDIR from the case screen.
As an Ops head I want KPIs and ageing.
Acceptance Criteria: Recon %, open cases by category, ageing buckets, breaches, compensation shown

Description: As a support agent I want to query status by RRN so I can answer customers.
Acceptance Criteria: 200 with status and exception block; 404 for unknown RRN

Description: As an analyst I want to re-run matching on selected records.
